description: This file defines a custom ViewGroup named FitCenterFrameLayout for Android applications. It centers and fits each child view within its bounds, maintaining the aspect ratio, by overriding onMeasure and onLayout methods.

classes.name: FitCenterFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that centers and fits its child views while maintaining aspect ratio, overriding onMeasure and onLayout methods.

methods.name: FitCenterFrameLayout
methods.description: Constructor initializing the custom layout with context, optionally with attribute set.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the layout and its children, ignoring children's specific measurements, sets its own size.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within the layout, centering and letterboxing them as necessary to maintain aspect ratio.
